{{short description|Encyclopedic website dedicated to knot theory}}
{{italic title}}
'''''The Knot Atlas''''' is a [[website]], an [[encyclopedia]] rather than atlas, dedicated to [[knot theory]]. It and its predecessor were created by mathematician [[Dror Bar-Natan]], who maintains the current site with Scott Morrison. According to Schiller, the site contains, "beautiful illustrations and detailed information about knots," as does ''KnotPlot.com''.<ref>Schiller, Christoph (2012). ''Motion Mountain, The Adventure of Physics – Vol. 5: Motion Inside Matter – Pleasure, Technology and Stars'', p.&nbsp;272. MotionMountain.net.</ref> According to the site itself, it is a knot [[atlas]] (collection of maps), theory [[database]], [[knowledge base]], and "a home for some [[computer program]]s".<ref>{{official website}}</ref>
